timing_conditions: One fixed core (mask 1), sequential evaluation solves, normal desktop activity. Full-case FEMM 4.2 baselines are archived original serial observations, not fresh matched controls. Fresh paired controls are single retained inputs only.

interpretation: Differences from archived FEMM 4.2 measure agreement, not error against a proven converged solution. Successive mesh changes and refined cross-engine probes must also be reviewed; mesh convergence of full FEMM 4.2 waveforms is not established.
